blocks.instruction: Read each situation carefully and answer the questions.

items.label: (a)
items.q: Where do we drop our letters to be sent? Who delivers letters to our home?
items.answer: In a postbox / at the post office (1). The postman (1).

items.label: (b)
items.q: A bird with a sharp, curved beak and sharp claws is sitting on a high branch, looking for prey. Name the bird and write what its beak and claws are used for.
items.answer: Eagle (1). The sharp curved beak and sharp claws help it catch and eat its prey (1).

items.label: (c)
items.q: Name the person who mends walls using bricks and cement. Write the name of one tool used for building walls.

items.label: (d)
items.q: A machine outside a bank lets Dada ji take out money at night. Name the device and write one benefit of using it.
items.answer: ATM (Automated Teller Machine) (1). We can take out money any time without waiting in a queue at the bank (1).

items.label: (e)
items.q: Mily's plate has dal, rice and spinach. Which food group is dal? Which is spinach?
items.answer: Dal (pulses) – body-building food (1). Spinach – protective food (1).

items.label: (c)

blocks.instruction: Answer the following questions in two or three sentences.

items.label: (i)
items.q: What is Van Mahotsav? When is it celebrated?
items.answer: Van Mahotsav is the Tree Planting Festival of India (1). It is celebrated every year from 1 July to 7 July in the rainy season (1). People plant trees to protect the environment and make the earth greener (1).

items.label: (ii)
items.q: Who is a nature scientist? Write about their role.
items.answer: A nature scientist is a person who studies plants and animals (1), like Abha Didi at Pachmarhi (1). They guide people in exploring nature and help protect plants and animals (1).

items.label: (iii)
items.q: What is a balanced diet?
items.answer: A balanced diet includes food from all three food groups in the right quantities (1) — protective foods the most, then body-building foods and some energy-giving foods (1). It keeps us healthy, active and happy (1).

answerPoints.point: Protective most, then body-building, some energy

items.label: (iv)
items.q: Write the full form of ATM. Write any two uses of an ATM.
items.answer: Automated Teller Machine (1). It lets us take out money any time (1) without going to the bank and waiting in a queue (1).

items.label: (v)
items.q: What is Gond art? How are the paints made for Gond art?
items.answer: Gond art is a form of painting on walls using natural colours (1), showing trees, animals, birds and humans (1). The paints are made from natural extracts of flowers and leaves and powdered coloured stones (1).

answerPoints.point: Paint from flowers, leaves, coloured stones

blocks.instruction: Complete the table in your answer book.

items.q: Compare communication in earlier times and in present times on these points: type of communication, speed, frequency, language, challenges faced.
items.answer: Type: letters, telegram – internet, social media, text messages (1). Speed: slow, weeks – seconds (1). Frequency: rarely – many times a day (1). Language: mostly local, handwritten – many languages, typed (1). Challenges: long wait, letters lost – wrong information spreads fast, needs phone and network (1).

items.label: (i)
items.q: A tree known as the flame of forest.

items.label: (ii)
items.q: A traditional food of Telangana with six different tastes.

items.label: (iii)
items.q: Small patches of forest protected by the local community.

items.label: (iv)
items.q: The river in Kanker over which the community built a bridge.

items.label: (i)
items.q: Different plants and animals are dependent on each other.
items.answer: Plants give food and shelter to animals, e.g. a tree gives food to a bird; animals help plants too (1). In the web of life, if one living being disappears the others are affected (1).

answerPoints.point: Web of life – removing one affects others

items.label: (ii)
items.q: We should avoid eating junk food.
items.answer: Junk food has high amounts of oil, salt and sugar (1). Eating it regularly and in large quantities makes us unhealthy (1).

items.label: (iii)
items.q: Drinking sufficient water should be a part of our healthy habits.
items.answer: Water helps digest food and keeps our skin and body healthy (1). It removes waste from the body through urine, sweat and faeces (1).

items.label: (i)
items.q: What is super food? Write the names of any two super foods.
items.answer: Millets, which are rich sources of nutrients, are called super food (1). Any two: jowar, bajra, ragi, jau (1).

items.label: (ii)
items.q: What things should be kept in a first-aid box?
items.answer: Any four (½ each): bandages, cotton, antiseptic cream or liquid, medicines, mosquito repellent cream, scissors, adhesive tape.

blocks.instruction: Answer in detail (five to six sentences).

items.label: (i)
items.q: Describe how the people of Chandan's village worked together for Van Mahotsav, and what they gained from it.
items.answer: Villagers, parents and children planned together under the banyan tree (1). Sameer fixed benches, Babita repaired the street light, Noor brought saplings (1). Groups cleaned the park, planted and watered saplings and cooked (1). The park became beautiful and everyone shared a feast (1). They felt happy and closer to each other, and the children decided to care for the park (1).

items.label: (ii)
items.q:
Describe the three food groups with two examples each, and say why we need food from all three.
OR
Write five ways in which we can care for plants and animals around us.
items.answer: Food option: energy-giving (rice, wheat, ghee) (1); body-building (pulses, milk, eggs) (1); protective (carrot, orange, spinach) (1); no single food has all nutrients (1); balanced plate keeps us healthy (1). OR option: 1 mark each for five ways — plant trees, keep food and water for birds, say no to plastic, reduce paper waste, clean-up drive, spread awareness, do not harm animals.
items.markingGuide: Five correct sentences on either option — 5; three or four — 3; one or two — 1.

items.q: Draw a compass showing the four directions (N, S, E, W), and next to it draw a simple map of your school with two landmarks around it, writing the direction of each landmark.
items.answer: Compass with N up, S down, E right, W left (1); school with two landmarks drawn and named (1); a correct direction written for each landmark (1).
items.markingGuide: All three parts correct — 3; two — 2; one — 1.

items.q: You are visiting a forest with your class. Write three rules you will follow, and explain in one sentence why these rules are important.
items.answer: Any three rules (½ each, 1½ total): do not tease or feed animals; do not damage trees and flowers; do not bring polythene; do not throw garbage; be careful in a new place. Why (1½): the forest is the home of plants and animals, and the rules keep them and us safe.
